# PHASE 1: Fresh auth + production health + GitHub HEAD parity
echo "================================================================"
echo "IVX IA END-TO-END QA — $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "================================================================"

# Step 1: Wake backend (free tier hibernates)
echo ""
echo "=== WAKING BACKEND ==="
for i in 1 2 3; do
  HTTP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 https://api.ivxholding.com/health 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$HTTP" = "200" ]; then echo "Backend awake (HTTP 200)"; break; fi
  echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $HTTP, retrying..."
  sleep 3
done

# Step 2: Get fresh owner token
echo ""
echo "=== FRESH OWNER AUTH ==="
curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}' > /tmp/auth_resp.json
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('/tmp/auth_resp.json'))
t = d.get('accessToken','')
open('/tmp/owner_token.txt','w').write(t)
ok = d.get('success', d.get('ok', False))
print(f'  success={ok} token_len={len(t)} token_prefix={t[:8]}...{t[-4:]}')
" 2>/dev/null
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/owner_token.txt)

# Step 3: Production health
echo ""
echo "=== PRODUCTION HEALTH ==="
curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/health | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(f'  status:     {d.get(\"status\")}')
print(f'  commit:     {d.get(\"commit\",\"?\")[:12]}')
print(f'  bootTime:   {d.get(\"bootTime\",\"?\")[:19]}')
print(f'  env:        {d.get(\"environment\")}')
print(f'  dbConfig:   {d.get(\"databaseConfigured\")}')
print(f'  supabase:   {d.get(\"supabaseManagementApiConfigured\")}')
" 2>/dev/null

# Step 4: GitHub HEAD
echo ""
echo "=== GITHUB HEAD ==="
GH_SHA=$(curl -s --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
  -d '{"action":"github_get_repo_head","confirm":true,"confirmText":"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE","input":{"branch":"main"}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('result',{}).get('headSha','?')[:12])" 2>/dev/null)
echo "  SHA: $GH_SHA"

# Step 5: SHA parity check
echo ""
echo "=== SHA PARITY ==="
PROD_SHA=$(curl -s --max-time 15 https://api.ivxholding.com/health 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('commit','?')[:12])" 2>/dev/null)
python3 -c "
gh = '$GH_SHA'; prod = '$PROD_SHA'
print(f'  GitHub HEAD:  {gh}')
print(f'  Production:   {prod}')
if gh == prod:
    print(f'  Parity:       ✅ MATCH — production is live on latest commit')
else:
    print(f'  Parity:       ⚠️ MISMATCH — production behind GitHub')
"
